rows.label: Operating Expenses
rows.formula: sum of the three printed expense rows stored in this file: Selling and Distribution Costs (stored negative), Administration and Other Expenses (stored positive) and Net Impairment Losses on Financial Assets (signed as printed); displayed negative as an expense, the convention the rest of this board uses

rows.label: Operating Profit (EBIT)
rows.formula: Gross Profit plus Other Income less total operating expenses

reconciliation_note: Net Profit (computed) matches the source's period total on every period. Operating Profit (EBIT) less Net Finance Costs plus Other Income equals Profit Before Tax does not hold in FY2022: the statement bridges operating profit to profit before tax through further lines (Finance Income; Loss From Continuing Operations; Net Impairment Losses On Financial Assets; Other Income; Profit From Discontinuing Operations) and the file's own bridge reproduces the filed profit before tax; both figures are shown unchanged.
derivedCellsNote: Individual blank cells derived from the same file own printed inputs, each tagged derived true with its formula and identity agreement rate.
unit: KES absolute; the statement printed Shs thousands
note: FY2022 to FY2025 rebuilt from the audited full year results published by Unga Group Plc. The FY2024 income tax row carried a positive 135,375,000, which cannot produce the printed net loss when subtracted from a loss before tax, so it is stored as the credit it is. Ratios for the rebuilt period(s) recomputed from the stored rows; ROE and ROA left blank where the balance sheet does not carry that period, rather than carried over from the old figures.
